consistency_audit.scope: Bounded VHE 3.4 restoration consistency audit; not complete interactive or byte parity.

reference.provenance: Original PE resources read directly; function comparisons use frozen native bodies in bin/obj/hammer/tool-parity. Live IDA MCP endpoint unavailable this run.

fixed.problem: Nonadvancing temporary-child loop, incorrect ownership transfer and history pause handling.
fixed.result: Export restores object ownership and prior history state and removes temporary shell brushes on completion or failure.

fixed.problem: GetLine returned at EOF without clearing its output. A caller copied uninitialized stack contents into global stuffed-line storage, corrupting editor state during repeated MAP reloads.
fixed.result: Initialize the output to an empty line before handling EOF. Reparse checks require the active document to remain intact.

fixed.problem: Picking left the selection projection installed; cached textures ignored live filtering changes; selected outline pass lacked native polygon offset/culling state.
fixed.result: Restore the normal camera projection after picking, refresh cached filters, restore selected solid outline state; mouse wheel immediately renders and updates camera variables.

fixed.problem: Repeated mode transitions lost remembered texture-bar visibility, while idle command routing disabled palette buttons.
fixed.result: Track face mode independently and guard repeated transitions. Preserve bar-owned controls through idle UI updates.
fixed.qualification: Idle command routing is an adapter repair; no claim of identical native MFC implementation.

fixed.problem: Source menu/shortcut/toolbar remnants and a missing 2D Create Object command route.
fixed.result: Original menus, accelerator tables, operations toolbar and Help destinations restored. Create Object uses existing tool handlers with the native translation guard.

fixed.problem: Source enum declared copy as zero while its bookkeeping used event types as bit masks.
fixed.result: Independent copy/delete/create/parent flags 1/2/4/8; first snapshot retained, repeated entries deduplicated.
Keep snapshots only its object. Parent changes have independent records; CopyFrom no longer transfers Parent. Proven mutation paths record pre-edit object data and hierarchy changes.

Rebuilds immediately destroy old nonserialized helpers. Their pointers are excluded from history; restored entity state regenerates helpers. Decal reference cleanup is separate from world unlink/keyframe removal. Actual helpers retain normal visibility flags.

Undo/Redo transfers deletion and creation ownership without leaking or double deletion in the exercised cases. Eviction, history disable and shutdown release retained deleted objects; world membership transitions maintain Source entity/culling caches.

Copied trees remain detached, so Copy no longer removes an unlinked copy through the live world lifecycle. The previous targetname buffer is initialized before unnamed-to-named redo dependency relinking.

Exactly 13 native accepted types; integer angle storage. Source readonly, extended description and omitted-default syntax removed. Existing defaults, choices, flags, reportable-copy behavior and installed SDK FGD remain passing.

source_adapters: Nonserialized generated helpers are omitted from pointer-based source history; native field behavior differs. IsTemporary remains unchanged because source visibility traversal requires visible helpers to be nontemporary.
Entity Undo notifications regenerate helper state and then update live dependencies; helper objects themselves are not independent persistent map objects.
Automatic mutation snapshots and parent records are scoped to the active map. Detached clipboard/prefab construction does not enter that map history.
Existing recursive KeepNew callers are retained as a source frontend compatibility path; native public KeepNew records one object.
Deleted-object cleanup on source history shutdown/disable differs from native cleanup mode 2 because this source history owns those detached objects.
World membership transitions use source document lifecycle APIs to preserve entity caches, culling, visibility and preload.
